title: Sea HUB
features:
SEA HUB - EVOMON | MORE FEATURES IN DISCORD!

----------------------------------------------------------

MAIN

----------------------------------------------------------

[+] Auto Claim - claims all available rewards every 5 seconds

[+] Auto Redeem Codes - automatically redeems gift codes

[+} Up to 50x battle speed

----------------------------------------------------------

FARMING - AUTO

----------------------------------------------------------

[+] Auto Nearest - fights / catches the closest mob or wild pet

[+] Auto Quest - accepts new quests and claims finished ones

[+] Quest Target - pick one specific quest to farm exclusively

[+] Auto Quest Farm - completes quest goals then claims automatically

[+] Auto Ascend - completes the Ascension Trial and breaks through tiers

----------------------------------------------------------

FARMING - MOB

----------------------------------------------------------

[+] Mob select - choose island and mob to farm

[+] Auto Farm Mob - loops fighting the selected mob

----------------------------------------------------------

FARMING - BOSS

----------------------------------------------------------

[+] Boss select - choose which boss to farm

[+] Auto Farm Boss - loops fighting the selected boss

----------------------------------------------------------

FARMING - CHEST

----------------------------------------------------------

[+] Chest Kinds - filter Normal / Boss chests

[+] Auto Chest - automatically collects nearby chests

----------------------------------------------------------

FARMING - DUEL

----------------------------------------------------------

[+] Duel select - choose a duel NPC to fight

[+] Auto Duel - fights duels manually (one NPC) or auto (low to high)

----------------------------------------------------------

FARMING - SUMMON

----------------------------------------------------------

[+] Tier / Boss select - choose which summoned boss to farm

[+] Combat Pet - pick which team pet fights the summoned boss

[+] Level Safety - skips summon if your team is too weak

[+] Auto Summon - summons, fights, collects and repeats until out of tokens

----------------------------------------------------------

HATCHING

----------------------------------------------------------

[+] Egg select - choose main egg and rare egg to hatch in parallel

[+] Hatch Ball - set which ball opens each egg type

[+] Auto Hatch - fills hatchers and opens eggs automatically

----------------------------------------------------------

PET

----------------------------------------------------------

[+] Sell Talent - set which talent grades get auto-sold

[+] Keep Rare - prevents Shiny / Prismatic pets from being sold

[+] Sell Now - sells matching pets immediately (with confirmation)

[+] Auto Sell - automatically sells when the box fills up

[+] Lock Loved / Lock All / Unlock All - batch lock controls

[+] Feed Pet - feed a selected team pet to level it up

[+] Auto Feed - feeds the selected pet automatically

[+] Auto Evolve - evolves pets that meet level and material requirements

----------------------------------------------------------

BATTLE

----------------------------------------------------------

[+] Auto Battle - automatically plays each turn in battle

[+] Best Skill - picks the highest-damage skill each turn

[+] Skill Slot - fallback skill slot when Best Skill is off

[+] Ultimate Priority - uses ultimate as soon as energy is ready
